notes.title: [Eaely Access v0.3.23] Game Version Update Notification
notes.content:
[h1]⚔️ SOS Update Announcement – May 2025[/h1]
Hello Guardians!
We’ve been tuning, slashing, and refining to bring you the latest SOS update! Here's what’s new and improved in this version:
[h2]🧭 Tutorial Overhaul[/h2]
[list]
[*] Added Skip System – now you can jump past sections if needed!
[*] Introduced Task System to guide you step-by-step.
[*] Updated tutorial dialogue font (Aggro Font) and character portraits.
[*] Increased Speed Mode from 1.0x ➜ 3.0x for a smoother experience.
[*] Fixed a bug where leftover notes appeared at event transitions.
[*] Tutorial functions no longer run during regular gameplay.
[*] Refreshed tutorial UI with updated images.
[/list]
[h2]🖼️ Profile Enhancements[/h2]
[list]
[*] Updated note images – removed outer borders for a cleaner look.
[/list]
[h2]🎵 In-Game Improvements[/h2]
[list]
[*] New Beat Circle effect added — toggle it on/off in settings!
[*] Monster animations revamped with updated animation speeds.
[*] Fixed bugs with Combo Monster behavior.
[*] Fixed an issue where Repeated-Tap Monsters occasionally caused incorrect MISS counts.
[*] Adjusted overall animation tree structure and timing for better flow.
[/list]
[h2]🛠️ Other Fixes & Improvements[/h2]
[list]
[*] "Sunshine 2T HD" chart updated with the correct version.
[*] Applied a new global font across the game for a fresher look.
[/list]

Thank you for your continuous rhythm and slash!
We’re always listening, always improving — and always cheering for your perfect combos! 💥🎶
Stay sharp,
– The SOS Dev Team

[h1]🎵 Hello Guardians![/h1]

[h2]🖼️ 3. Profile & Animation Fixes[/h2]
[h3]Now when you click your profile, your image updates accordingly![/h3]
[list]
[*] Fixed a bug where the Desert Idle Animation wasn’t looping.
[/list]

Thank you for continuing to protect the world of SOS!
Keep slashing, stay rhythmic — and as always, your feedback helps make the game better. 🎶

With gratitude,
The SOS Dev Team

[h1]🎵 Sound of Slash (SOS) Update Announcement! ⚔️[/h1]
Hello, Guardians!
We’re back with a minor but meaningful update for Sound of Slash (SOS). Thanks to your valuable feedback, we’ve made a couple of important adjustments to improve your gameplay experience from the very beginning. Check out the details below!
[h2]🛠️ Calibration Improvements[/h2]
[h3]🎧 New Calibration Track (120BPM Metronome)[/h3]
[list]
[*] We heard from many new Guardians that the original calibration song was too fast, making it difficult to properly set up the rhythm.
[*] To make the process smoother, we’ve added a new calibration track based on a steady 120BPM metronome. Now, even newcomers can calibrate with ease and jump into battle confidently!
[/list]

[h2]🎼 Music List Adjustments[/h2]
[h3]🎵 Cleaned Up Test Tracks & Missing Notes[/h3]
[list]
[*] In the previous version, a few tracks were missing notes or were uploaded for testing purposes.
[*] We’ve done a full clean-up to ensure that every song is polished and ready to enjoy. Dive back in and slash to the beat without interruption!
[/list]

🔧 As always, your feedback continues to shape SOS into something greater. Thank you for being part of this journey.
🔥 Have Fun Slash! ⚔️
— Sound of Slash Development Team

notes.content:
[h1][b]🎵 Sound of Slash (SOS) Update Announcement! ⚔️[/b][/h1]
Hello, Guardians!
The Sound of Slash (SOS) Team is back with an exciting update! This patch includes UI improvements, enhanced hit effects, bug fixes, and adjustments to the scoring system. Check out the details below to enhance your gameplay experience!

[h2][b]🔥 Art Updates[/b][/h2]
[h3]🎨 Combo Number UI Improvement[/h3]
[list]
[*] The simple number display has been redesigned to better fit the Sound of Slash aesthetic, giving combo numbers a more impactful and dynamic look!
[/list]
[h3]🎨 Fever Mode Combo Multiplier UI Improvement[/h3]
[list]
[*] We’ve updated the UI to clearly show how the Fever Mode combo multiplier is applied to your existing combo once Fever Mode ends.
[/list]
[h3]🎨 Enhanced Hit Effects[/h3]
[list]
[*] To create a more action-packed feel, hit effects have been adjusted to appear more accurately at the attack point, making each hit feel more impactful!
[/list]
[h3]🎨 Fixed Chain Note Image Bug[/h3]
[list]
[*] Fixed a visual misalignment between the monster's position and the starting point of long chain notes.
[/list]
[h3]🎨 Song Cover Images Added[/h3]
[list]
[*] Music Selection now features cover images for each song, bringing more personality and visual appeal to the track selection screen. 🎼
[/list]

[h2][b]🛠️ Bug Fixes[/b][/h2]
[h3]🐞 Score Scene Fix[/h3]
[list]
[*] Fixed an issue where pressing the Enter key would unexpectedly start the counter.
[/list]
[h3]🐞 Music Selection Fix[/h3]
[list]
[*] Previously, the most recent score was displayed. Now, the highest score for each song is correctly shown.
[/list]
[h3]🐞 Pause Menu Fix[/h3]
[list]
[*] Fixed a bug where the Pause Menu could be triggered by pressing ESC during the initial countdown or after resuming the game. This issue has been resolved for a smoother experience.
[/list]
[h3]🐞 Character Motion Adjustments[/h3]
[list]
[*] Minor adjustments have been made to improve character motion.
[/list]

[h2][b]📈 Score Adjustments[/b][/h2]
[h3]🔢 Updated Grade Criteria & Calculation[/h3]
[list]
[*] The grading system has been adjusted for fairer and more challenging gameplay!
[/list]

🎼 With your feedback, SOS continues to grow and evolve—we’re building this game together! We’ll keep listening to your ideas and suggestions to bring you even better updates. Thank you for your support, and enjoy the game!

🔥 Let’s Play & Slash the Rhythm! ⚔️

notes.title: [Eaely Access v0.3.11] Game Version Update Notification
notes.content:
Hello, Guardians of Sound of Slash!

We are excited to bring you the latest update for Sound of Slash! Here's what's new:

[b]Note Judgment System Update[/b]
We have identified an issue regarding the note judgment system. In the past, if you missed one note, it would cause subsequent notes to be affected and also be judged as a miss. We've completely revised this system to ensure that note judgments are more accurate and fair. Now, missing a note will no longer impact the rest of your performance, allowing for a more stable and enjoyable gameplay experience!

[b]New Music Added[/b]
We've added a variety of new tracks to Sound of Slash! Get ready to enjoy fresh beats across different genres and styles. These new songs will be rolled out gradually, so stay tuned and check out the updates!

We are committed to providing a better and more exciting experience for you all. Thank you for your continuous support, and we hope you enjoy the new features!

Stay tuned for more updates and keep the feedback coming!
Keep slashing, Guardians!

notes.title: [Eaely Access v0.3.8] Game Version Update Notification
notes.content:
Hello, Guardians of Sound of Slash!
We're excited to bring you some major updates! There are various improvements and new content to enhance your gaming experience, so let's dive in!

[b]In-Game Updates[/b]
[list]
[*] Note Update: We’ve received feedback regarding some songs where the notes would unexpectedly skip or be off-sync, causing discomfort during gameplay. To address this, we've implemented a large-scale update to the note system, ensuring a smoother experience.
[/list]
[list]
[*] Monster vs. Normal Note Differentiation: We recognized that the difference between monster notes and normal notes wasn't as clear as intended. As a result, we've made significant visual improvements to make them more intuitive and visually distinct for players.
[/list]
[list]
[*] Offset Issue with Increased Speed: We also noticed that speeding up the game caused note offset issues. To fix this, we've revised the calculation formulas for more accurate synchronization during faster gameplay.
[/list]

[b]Art & Visual Updates[/b]
[list]
[*] Visual Balance Adjustments: Based on feedback about difficulty distinguishing between the background, characters, and monsters, we’ve made adjustments to the overall visual balance to enhance clarity and visibility.
[/list]
[list]
[*] New Skin Release: We’re excited to introduce a new Horror version skin for G, the protagonist of Sound of Slash! Check it out for a new, thrilling look.
[/list]

[b]UI Updates[/b]
[list]
[*] Music Selection UI Overhaul: We’ve redesigned the Music Selection UI to better reflect the unique identity of Sound of Slash while also making it more user-friendly. We appreciate your feedback and look forward to hearing what you think!
[/list]

[b]Early Access Benefits[/b]
[list]
[*] Unlock All Content: Previously, certain songs, icons, skins, and backgrounds had to be unlocked by completing missions. Now, we've made them all available right from the start! Enjoy a variety of skins and backgrounds as you play, and feel free to share your thoughts with us for future updates.
[/list]

[b]2024 GStar Exhibition[/b]
[list]
[*] Sound of Slash will be showcased at GStar 2024 in Busan, Korea, from November 14th to 17th! We hope to see many of our Guardians there, and we’d love your support!
[/list]

[b]A Final Note[/b]
At Ussistant Studio, we are dedicated to continuously improving Sound of Slash based on your valuable feedback. We’re here to assist you in making the game better, and we can’t wait to keep growing together with you.
Thank you so much for your continued support, and we look forward to hearing your thoughts!

Thank you!

-Ussistant Studio
